releases.name: Hungry Horrors
releases.summary: Hungry Horrors is a roguelite deck-building adventure where cooking is your weapon of choice against mythical monsters from British and Irish folklore. Prepare and serve authentic regional dishes to appease these creatures and progress through a world where culinary skills can mean the difference between survival and an unexpected end.

releases.name: Smiley Arena
releases.summary: Defend your turf against endless waves of grinning enemies! Pick from 6 unique smiley classes with their own abilities, build and upgrade turrets across multiple lanes, and take down ever-tougher bosses – a colorful tower-defense hybrid built for replayability.

releases.name: Attic Antiquities
releases.summary: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

releases.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
releases.summary:
When Zeus unleashed his wrath upon Atlantis, the proud city was struck down and swallowed by the waves. 

But all is not lost. In Atlantis Fantasy, choose to play as a god or goddess and answer Poseidon’s call to restore his fallen kingdom. 

Through strategic management, mythology, and city-building, forge a new underwater empire worthy of the Olympians.

releases.name: Whispers Of The Lost Ticket
releases.summary: Whispers of the Lost Ticket is an exploration horror game centered around uncovering the events surrounding Guilded Hollow Carnival through story and event interactions while shadowy forces try to stop you. Uncover the secrets of those who came before you, as the carnival welcomes its final visitor

releases.name: Gym Bros: LooksMaxx
releases.summary: Get swol, race to the mirror, and strike ridiculous poses for clout in this multiplayer social VR party game. Compete with friends, customize your bro, and climb the leaderboard. Skip leg day, flex for the feed, and become the ultimate giga-chad. Do it. We believe in you.

releases.name: Verity's Revenge
releases.summary: Play through Verity’s game while they come to life right beside you, waiting for you to get distracted. Can you keep your focus and reach 12 points before it's too late?

releases.name: Undead Gunline
releases.summary: Undead Gunline is a fast-paced, single-player turret shooter. Aim and fire with your mouse to stop zombie waves on a desert highway, then spend earned resources on upgrades to strengthen your rolling gun platform and push farther down the road.

releases.name: Pipkind: A Dice Puzzle Adventure
releases.summary: Pop matching dice, collect playful outfits and help 100 quirky friends in a colorful retro puzzle adventure. Explore a growing village, tackle 1,000 campaign levels, or chase your best score in an ever-faster Marathon. Think fast: wrong shots stack up!
